title: openinference, openai-agents: top-level span status is OK

tries.explanation: In `on_trace_end`, the root span is unconditionally set to `Status(StatusCode.OK)` even when the run raised an exception. The SDK records errors on the agent span via `span.error`, but the root (trace-level) span never checks for that. The fix tracks whether any span in a trace ended with an error and propagates that to the root span's status in `on_trace_end`.

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

import pytest
from agents import Agent, Runner
from agents.exceptions import MaxTurnsExceeded
from agents.items import ModelResponse
from agents.models.interface import Model
from agents.usage import Usage
from openai.types.responses import (
    ResponseFunctionToolCall,
    ResponseOutputMessage,
    ResponseOutputText,
)
from opentelemetry.sdk import trace as trace_sdk
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace import ReadableSpan
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace.export import SimpleSpanProcessor
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace.export.in_memory_span_exporter import InMemorySpanExporter
from opentelemetry.trace import StatusCode

from openinference.instrumentation.openai_agents import OpenAIAgentsInstrumentor


class _AlwaysToolModel(Model):
    async def get_response(self, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> ModelResponse:
        return ModelResponse(
            output=[
                ResponseFunctionToolCall(
                    type="function_call",
                    call_id="call-1",
                    name="no_such_tool",
                    arguments="{}",
                )
            ],
            usage=Usage(),
            response_id=None,
        )

    def stream_response(self, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> Any:
        raise NotImplementedError


class _ErrorModel(Model):
    async def get_response(self, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> ModelResponse:
        raise RuntimeError("simulated LLM failure")

    def stream_response(self, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> Any:
        raise NotImplementedError


class _SuccessModel(Model):
    async def get_response(self, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> ModelResponse:
        return ModelResponse(
            output=[
                ResponseOutputMessage(
                    id="m1",
                    type="message",
                    role="assistant",
                    status="completed",
                    content=[
                        ResponseOutputText(
                            type="output_text", text="Hello!", annotations=[]
                        )
                    ],
                )
            ],
            usage=Usage(),
            response_id=None,
        )

    def stream_response(self, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> Any:
        raise NotImplementedError


@pytest.fixture
def exporter() -> Any:
    _exporter = InMemorySpanExporter()
    provider = trace_sdk.TracerProvider()
    provider.add_span_processor(SimpleSpanProcessor(_exporter))
    OpenAIAgentsInstrumentor().instrument(tracer_provider=provider)
    yield _exporter
    OpenAIAgentsInstrumentor().uninstrument()


def _root_span(spans: list[ReadableSpan]) -> ReadableSpan:
    roots = [s for s in spans if s.parent is None]
    assert len(roots) == 1, f"expected one root span, got {len(roots)}"
    return roots[0]


async def test_root_span_is_error_when_max_turns_exceeded(exporter: InMemorySpanExporter) -> None:
    agent = Agent(name="LoopAgent", model=_AlwaysToolModel())
    with pytest.raises(MaxTurnsExceeded):
        await Runner.run(agent, "go", max_turns=1)

    spans = list(exporter.get_finished_spans())
    root = _root_span(spans)
    assert root.status.status_code == StatusCode.ERROR, (
        f"expected root span ERROR, got {root.status.status_code}"
    )


async def test_root_span_is_error_when_model_raises(exporter: InMemorySpanExporter) -> None:
    agent = Agent(name="ErrorAgent", model=_ErrorModel())
    with pytest.raises(Exception):
        await Runner.run(agent, "go")

    spans = list(exporter.get_finished_spans())
    root = _root_span(spans)
    assert root.status.status_code == StatusCode.ERROR, (
        f"expected root span ERROR, got {root.status.status_code}"
    )


async def test_root_span_is_ok_when_run_succeeds(exporter: InMemorySpanExporter) -> None:
    agent = Agent(name="OkAgent", model=_SuccessModel())
    result = await Runner.run(agent, "hi")
    assert result.final_output == "Hello!"

    spans = list(exporter.get_finished_spans())
    root = _root_span(spans)
    assert root.status.status_code == StatusCode.OK, (
        f"expected root span OK, got {root.status.status_code}"
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

import pytest
from agents import Agent, Runner, function_tool
from agents.exceptions import MaxTurnsExceeded
from agents.items import ModelResponse
from agents.models.interface import Model
from agents.usage import Usage
from openai.types.responses import (
    ResponseFunctionToolCall,
    ResponseOutputMessage,
    ResponseOutputText,
)
from opentelemetry.sdk import trace as trace_sdk
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace import ReadableSpan
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace.export import SimpleSpanProcessor
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace.export.in_memory_span_exporter import InMemorySpanExporter
from opentelemetry.trace import StatusCode

from openinference.instrumentation.openai_agents import OpenAIAgentsInstrumentor


@function_tool
def noop_tool() -> str:
    """Does nothing."""
    return "done"


class _AlwaysCallNoopModel(Model):
    async def get_response(self, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> ModelResponse:
        return ModelResponse(
            output=[
                ResponseFunctionToolCall(
                    type="function_call",
                    call_id="call-1",
                    name="noop_tool",
                    arguments="{}",
                )
            ],
            usage=Usage(),
            response_id=None,
        )

    def stream_response(self, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> Any:
        raise NotImplementedError


class _SuccessModel(Model):
    async def get_response(self, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> ModelResponse:
        return ModelResponse(
            output=[
                ResponseOutputMessage(
                    id="m1",
                    type="message",
                    role="assistant",
                    status="completed",
                    content=[
                        ResponseOutputText(
                            type="output_text", text="Hello!", annotations=[]
                        )
                    ],
                )
            ],
            usage=Usage(),
            response_id=None,
        )

    def stream_response(self, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> Any:
        raise NotImplementedError


@pytest.fixture
def exporter() -> Any:
    _exporter = InMemorySpanExporter()
    provider = trace_sdk.TracerProvider()
    provider.add_span_processor(SimpleSpanProcessor(_exporter))
    OpenAIAgentsInstrumentor().instrument(tracer_provider=provider)
    yield _exporter
    OpenAIAgentsInstrumentor().uninstrument()


def _root_span(spans: list[ReadableSpan]) -> ReadableSpan:
    roots = [s for s in spans if s.parent is None]
    assert len(roots) == 1, f"expected one root span, got {len(roots)}"
    return roots[0]


async def test_root_span_is_error_when_max_turns_exceeded(
    exporter: InMemorySpanExporter,
) -> None:
    agent = Agent(name="LoopAgent", model=_AlwaysCallNoopModel(), tools=[noop_tool])
    with pytest.raises(MaxTurnsExceeded):
        await Runner.run(agent, "go", max_turns=1)

    spans = list(exporter.get_finished_spans())
    root = _root_span(spans)
    assert root.status.status_code == StatusCode.ERROR, (

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

import pytest
from agents import Agent, Runner, function_tool
from agents.exceptions import MaxTurnsExceeded
from agents.items import ModelResponse
from agents.models.interface import Model
from agents.usage import Usage
from openai.types.responses import (
    ResponseFunctionToolCall,
    ResponseOutputMessage,
    ResponseOutputText,
)
from opentelemetry.sdk import trace as trace_sdk
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace import ReadableSpan
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace.export import SimpleSpanProcessor
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace.export.in_memory_span_exporter import InMemorySpanExporter
from opentelemetry.trace import StatusCode

from openinference.instrumentation.openai_agents import OpenAIAgentsInstrumentor


@function_tool
def noop_tool() -> str:
    """Does nothing."""
    return "done"


@function_tool
def raising_tool() -> str:
    """Always raises."""
    raise ValueError("tool error")


class _AlwaysCallNoopModel(Model):
    """Always asks for noop_tool, causing MaxTurnsExceeded when max_turns=1."""

    async def get_response(self, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> ModelResponse:
        return ModelResponse(
            output=[
                ResponseFunctionToolCall(
                    type="function_call",
                    call_id="call-1",
                    name="noop_tool",
                    arguments="{}",
                )
            ],
            usage=Usage(),
            response_id=None,
        )

    def stream_response(self, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> Any:
        raise NotImplementedError


class _CallRaisingThenAnswerModel(Model):
    """Calls raising_tool once, then returns a final answer."""

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._calls = 0

    async def get_response(self, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> ModelResponse:
        self._calls += 1
        if self._calls == 1:
            return ModelResponse(
                output=[
                    ResponseFunctionToolCall(
                        type="function_call",
                        call_id="call-1",
                        name="raising_tool",
                        arguments="{}",
                    )
                ],
                usage=Usage(),
                response_id=None,
            )
        return ModelResponse(
            output=[
                ResponseOutputMessage(
                    id="m1",
                    type="message",
                    role="assistant",
                    status="completed",
                    content=[
                        ResponseOutputText(
                            type="output_text",
                            text="Done despite tool error.",
                            annotations=[],
                        )
                    ],
                )
            ],
            usage=Usage(),
            response_id=None,
        )

    def stream_response(self, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> Any:
        raise NotImplementedError


class _SuccessModel(Model):
    async def get_response(self, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> ModelResponse:
        return ModelResponse(
            output=[
                ResponseOutputMessage(
                    id="m1",
                    type="message",
                    role="assistant",
                    status="completed",
                    content=[
                        ResponseOutputText(
                            type="output_text", text="Hello!", annotations=[]
                        )
                    ],
                )
            ],
            usage=Usage(),
            response_id=None,
        )

    def stream_response(self, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> Any:
        raise NotImplementedError


@pytest.fixture
def exporter() -> Any:
    _exporter = InMemorySpanExporter()
    provider = trace_sdk.TracerProvider()
    provider.add_span_processor(SimpleSpanProcessor(_exporter))
    OpenAIAgentsInstrumentor().instrument(tracer_provider=provider)
    yield _exporter
    OpenAIAgentsInstrumentor().uninstrument()


def _root_span(spans: list[ReadableSpan]) -> ReadableSpan:
    roots = [s for s in spans if s.parent is None]
    assert len(roots) == 1, f"expected one root span, got {len(roots)}"
    return roots[0]


async def test_root_span_is_error_when_max_turns_exceeded(
    exporter: InMemorySpanExporter,
) -> None:
    """When the run raises MaxTurnsExceeded the root span must be ERROR."""
    agent = Agent(name="LoopAgent", model=_AlwaysCallNoopModel(), tools=[noop_tool])
    with pytest.raises(MaxTurnsExceeded):
        await Runner.run(agent, "go", max_turns=1)

    spans = list(exporter.get_finished_spans())
    root = _root_span(spans)
    assert root.status.status_code == StatusCode.ERROR, (
        f"expected root span ERROR, got {root.status.status_code}"
    )


async def test_root_span_is_ok_when_tool_raises_but_run_succeeds(
    exporter: InMemorySpanExporter,
) -> None:
    """When a tool raises but the run still finishes, the root span must be OK."""
    agent = Agent(
        name="ToolErrorAgent",
        model=_CallRaisingThenAnswerModel(),
        tools=[raising_tool],
    )
    result = await Runner.run(agent, "go")
    assert "Done despite tool error" in result.final_output

    spans = list(exporter.get_finished_spans())
    root = _root_span(spans)
    assert root.status.status_code == StatusCode.OK, (
        f"expected root span OK when tool raises but run succeeds, got {root.status.status_code}"
    )


async def test_root_span_is_ok_when_run_succeeds(
    exporter: InMemorySpanExporter,
) -> None:
    """A clean successful run must keep the root span OK."""
    agent = Agent(name="OkAgent", model=_SuccessModel())
    result = await Runner.run(agent, "hi")
    assert result.final_output == "Hello!"

    spans = list(exporter.get_finished_spans())
    root = _root_span(spans)
    assert root.status.status_code == StatusCode.OK, (
        f"expected root span OK, got {root.status.status_code}"
    )
